questions: How does the development of numerical codes for studying the evolution of dust and gas in turbulent molecular clouds and protoplanetary discs relate to the computational savings achieved in deriving class membership distributions from observational errors?

What connections can be drawn between the discovery of spiral-arm-like features in protoplanetary disks using high angular resolution imaging instruments and the analysis of M dwarfs through high-resolution infrared spectra?
What is the nature of the processes governing the formation and evolution of protoplanetary disks and their role in planet formation?
How might the interplay between conventional charging by ambient plasma and additional mechanisms influenced by cosmic rays reshape our understanding of dust dynamics in the interstellar medium?
Could the established consensus on molecular ion abundances in protoplanetary disks be fundamentally reconsidered in light of alternative interpretations of N2H+ ring formation?
